summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (14 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet, PR 1759). Nothing was run: no tests, black, mypy, or imports. Verification was by reading only. Known risk: the module-level open passes a str mode into the overloaded Progress.open, which mypy will likely reject; not suppressed because the spec permits no such suppression. Unverified: Python 3.6 compatibility of the RawIOBase + BinaryIO multiple inheritance and the docs examples. No commit was made.
